name: Your Story
source:
- Sometimes I wonder if there’s a meaning to it…
					- A meaning?
					- A purpose? Any reason behind it all? Does it lead anywhere?
					- The “meaning”... you need to find your own. Maybe even come up with one. Make one for yourself.
					- I don’t know if I can… Sigh, I don’t even think I’m ready yet…
					- No one’s ready. After all, it’s everyone’s first time.
					- First time what?
					- Living.

Lia is a young girl at a turning point of her life. Overwhelmed by boredom and monotony (who couldn’t relate?) suddenly notices a change. Can she adapt to the new reality?
					Is there, after all, a meaning to her existence?

Lead Lia on the journey through the most important moments of her life - ones that can change her forever.
Find out who you are and what’s your actual role.
Your decisions have an impact on Lia’s life - it’s up to you, what might happen to her. Uncover the paths and secrets. Reveal the outcome of your own choices.

[From the [url=https://gameload.gg/yourstory/]official website[/url]]
translation:
“有时候，我会想，这一切究竟有没有意义……”
“意义？”
“目的？这一切背后的理由？它究竟会通向哪里？”
“‘意义’……你需要找到属于自己的。也许，还得自己想一个，亲手赋予自己意义。”
“我不知道自己能不能做到……唉，我甚至觉得自己还没准备好……”
“没有人准备好了。毕竟，对每个人来说，这都是第一次。”
“第一次做什么？”
“活着。”

莉娅是个正站在人生转折点上的少女。无聊与单调让她不堪重负——谁又没有过这种感受呢？而她突然察觉到了变化。她能适应新的现实吗？
她的存在，究竟有没有意义？

引领莉娅走过人生中最重要的时刻，那些足以永远改变她的时刻。
弄清自己是谁，以及自己真正扮演的角色。
你的决定会影响莉娅的人生，她将经历什么，取决于你。发现不同的道路与秘密，揭晓自己选择带来的结果。

[摘自[url=https://gameload.gg/yourstory/]官方网站[/url]]
